description_en: Queries the list of Data Service folders
description_zh: 调用ListDataServiceFolders查询数据服务文件夹列表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-data-service-folders --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --project-id 10001 --tenant-id 10002 --group-id ds_123abc --folder-name-keyword '文件夹名称关键词' --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataServiceFolders

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大50条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the DataStudio page, click your username in the upper-right corner, and select Menu > User Info
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the business process to which the folder belongs
parameters.help_zh: 指定文件夹所属业务流程的ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the folder name. Substring matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 文件夹名称关键词，可以进行子串匹配
parameters.name: folder_name_keyword
